name: direction-adjust
description: Capture a small-to-medium course correction found mid-task in your own work: record a D-N entry in DECISIONS.md, update TASK_STATE.md, and route back to the command. Use when it is worth recording, does not invalidate the whole approach, and the current slice stays recoverable with a small plan change. Do not use for PR feedback (use pr-feedback-ingest or post-review-pivot), scope invalidation (use task-init), trivia (use capture-observation), loops (use im-stuck), or reopened decisions (use decision-interview).
